industries.heading: Accelerating solutions to the industry’s toughest challenges
industries.text: Our solutions help manufacture, maintain, or advance nearly every vehicle in the world. So, when we apply our diverse portfolio of technologies and 100-plus years of expertise to customer challenges, we can advance efficiency, performance, longevity, and safety for the entire industry.
industries.alt: Photo of a robotic arm with 3M Finesse-it robotic paint repair head polishing a car hood

industries.heading: Making your brand, people, and facility shine
industries.text: No matter where your company shows up, or where its work gets done, 3M solutions are here to make a difference. From cleaning and safety supplies to eye-catching graphic and architectural films, we aim to enhance your brand experience.
industries.alt: Photo of a technician installing 3M energy efficiency film on the windows of a commercial building

industries.heading: Reinventing the everyday to make a world of difference
industries.text: Whether you’re at home, at work, or on the go, our solutions help tackle your to-dos. From bandages and sandpaper to décor and cleaning, we’ve spent more than 100 years making what you need to get the job done.
industries.alt: Photo of a shopper looking at 3M home care products

industries.heading: Expanding what’s possible through form and function
industries.text: Bold ideas. Aesthetics. Efficiency. These are the tasks architects, designers, and construction companies take on every day. 3M is here to help. From state-of-the-art window films and roofing materials to ultra-strong adhesives and proven electrical solutions, our careful craftsmanship delivers the consistent and transformative results you strive for.
industries.alt: Photo of a commercial office space with 3M Fasara film applied to glass walls

industries.heading: Building technology to power the tools of tomorrow
industries.text: Our advanced solutions are helping companies deliver more robust mobile devices, more stable and efficient networks, and brighter, clearer displays. By consistently innovating and combining technologies, we are enabling a faster, more connected future.
industries.alt: Photo of internal components of VR headset with 3M Harp lenses

industries.heading: Sparking the transformation of global energy systems
industries.text: We’re reimagining the future of energy and optimizing electrical infrastructure for a brighter tomorrow. Through continuous innovation, we can improve existing solutions and develop new approaches that enhance and sustain daily life
industries.alt: Photo of a gloved hand holding 3M hydrogen iridium catalyst sheet for hydrogen fuel capture

industries.heading: A world of capability in service of your communities
industries.text: As a global enterprise, we have a long-established understanding of federal, state, and local government needs. By drawing on our vast resources, technology platforms, and differentiated expertise, we create effective solutions for the most pressing challenges and provide unparalleled support for priority initiatives.
industries.alt: Photo of a person overlooking the Lincoln Memorial landscape in Washington D.C.

industries.heading: Making the complex world of manufacturing run smoothly
industries.text: When it comes to fabricating, assembling or processing anything around the world, 3M knows efficiency is key. For you, for your team, and for your bottom line. From ultra-strong abrasives that keep processes running seamlessly, to futuristic materials that literally lighten your workload, and so much more, innovative 3M solutions help you create what’s next.
industries.alt: Photo of a technician sanding surface with 3M Xtract sander and personal protective equipment

industries.heading: Advancing safe and sound through science
industries.text: We create safety solutions that help protect people and control their environments across industries. From personal protective equipment to infrastructure improvements, our technologies help ensure safety in a changing world and allow you to focus on your work with confidence.
industries.alt: Photo of an industrial worker wearing 3M personal protective equipment

industries.heading: Helping the world move safely and efficiently
industries.text: Our science is propelling the transportation industry forward with safer, faster, and lighter technologies across the seas, sky, and land. With solutions that can scale from cargo ships to scooters, we can help all manufacturers, transporters, and travelers achieve their goals.
industries.alt: Photo of a commercial airplane parked on an airport tarmac
